Abandoned mines


Setting

This meeting place in the abandoned mines is associated with the imprisoned Lu-a-Jalla. Her rescue turns the search for the Princess into the search for her beloved At-Zako and opens the next stage of Zak’s journey. [1, 2, 3]

Lu-a-Jalla beneath the mines

The former punishment cell is empty. Zak follows the trail deeper into the Forbidden Catacombs until he finds Lu-a-Jalla, who first mistakes him for another captor. She has escaped the mercenaries and found protection through the ancient treaty between Joons and Wormheads. She rejects the nickname Princess and explains that Diera imprisoned her out of jealousy over the governor. Zak falls in love with her, but she remains faithful to At-Zako, who drew the Joon Curse away from her. Zak promises to respect that bond. They return to Tka-Rik, and the next mission becomes the search for her missing beloved on Suslanger. [4, 2, 5, 6, 3]
